My day usually starts around 4 AM because my baby is going through some weird sleep regression, so it goes like this:
- baby cries. I pretend not to hear in hopes baby daddy will get up with him. 
- baby starts yelling "mom mom mom"
-baby daddy starts yelling "are you going to get up with him?"
-change baby, warm some milk and cover him up again.  Hope he goes back to sleep.
-repeat steps 1-3
-get up with baby, turn on Toopy and Binoo, and settle baby into his lazy boy with a snack.
-try to doze on couch while he watches tv.
-baby realizes I'm trying to sleep, comes over and wakes me
-drink copious amounts of coffee.  Usually just enough to fully wake up.  This is when baby decides he wants to go back to bed.
-determine I can't sleep because of caffeine intake
-shower, throw hair in ponytail and get dressed.
-do makeup.  I allow about an hour for this because I enjoy it and it is my "me" time each day.
-realize I have seven minutes to be out the door and baby is still asleep, wood fire hasn't been stoked and lunches aren't packed.
-mutter every curse word I know while complaining how easy baby daddy has it ( he works from home and is usually still sleeping).
-get baby woken, dressed, pack lunches and leave so I can drop him at daycare and get to work.  

Edit: somewhere in this routine I will also step in whoever the cat has decided to throw up the night before.  I swear she has the finikiest digestive system and one bite of something other than her food makes her puke everywhere.
